newsitem.title: THAILAND: Kang Yong to boost refrigerator production.
newsitem.headline: Kang Yong to boost refrigerator production.

text.p: Thai electrical appliance maker Kang Yong Electric Plc said on Friday the company will invest 342 million baht next year to double its refrigerator production capacity to 500,000 units per year.

In a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Kang Yong said the increase in its refrigerator production will lower its production cost and to enable it to expand into new markets in the Southeast Asia region.
Kang Yong said it will also spend another 110 million baht in 1997 to buy new machines for the production of its other electrical products.
